title: Build and artifact identity
summary: Release-owned exact-pair consumer proofs dispatch platform-release-pin-check.yml at the immutable tag yoke-deploy/consumer-<consumer-sha>, created sessionlessly on the dispatch permission, so a moved consumer main cannot change the workflow source. The consumer records the dispatched commit as the proof identity in its run-name, "platform-release-pin-check <product> on <dispatched sha> [yoke-dispatch:<id>]"; its optional consumer_sha input only asserts that commit and fails on a mismatch. The Platform release route reuses only a successful dispatched run whose head commit is the consumer its title names, and a verdict naming a different consumer commit still refuses. A refused or unverified tag names its recovery and dispatches nothing. Ordinary producer PR and main-push events do not dispatch consumer checks; explicit diagnostics use the existing pin-check workflow. A cold release creates and awaits proof, and simultaneous stage/prod callers share one proof per pair. A pending join retries that same request id for about two minutes; any other dispatch error, and an exhausted budget, stay unavailable.
